item.title: [SwiftHFR] Reader: an MP link naming a message of a later page shows page 1 as current (HFR answers in place)

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Something does not work as expected

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Specified and ready to be picked

labels.name: origin: parity
labels.description: Parity gap with legacy @ 2440d79 found later (H.1 (a) rows, UXD (a) items, parity checks)

item.body: ### Summary As a member opening a link to a message of a multi-page private conversation (bookmark, permalink, quote link), I want the reader to know which page it is showing, so that the page counter, « next », « previous » and refresh work from that page. ### Problem For `cat=prive`, HFR answers `forum2.php?config=hfr.inc&cat=prive&post=&page=1&numreponse=` **in place** (200, no `Location`) with the page that holds `M`, while the URL still says `page=1` (`R1315c`: M on page 3, the body is page 3; `R388a`: page 1). A public topic redirects instead (`R25`), and the reader relies on that redirect. Path (at `dev-swift` 97a060bd): - `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRParsing/Links/HFRLinkRoute+Routing.swift:43-46` keeps `numreponse` (and drops `page`) for `cat=prive` links too. - `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicPageSource.swift:44-47,61-63` sends `page=1&numreponse=M`. - `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRParsing/Topic/TopicPageMetadataParser.swift:27` takes `currentPage` from the URL: 1 on page 3. - `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift:626` sets the shown target to that page 1. Effects (on a 4-page conversation, M on page 3): the reader shows « 1 / 4 », « next » loads page 2, « previous » is disabled, a refresh reloads page 1. ### Fix direction When the request names a message, take the current page from the pager's current page (`N` in the pager, present on `R1315a`/`R1315b` and on public pages), not from the URL; keep the URL rule otherwise (legacy Q18, `requestedURLIsNotClamped`). Correct the comments that say HFR redirects for every `numreponse` link: `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicPageSource.swift:45`, `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRNetwork/Endpoints/HFREndpoint+Topics.swift:26-27`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderTarget.swift:23-24`. Check legacy's handling of the same answer before choosing (`87fe0d1c`). ### Sources `R1315c` (meta only; body byte for byte `R1315b` but two lines), `R1315a`, `R1315b` (PR #1367, HFR-PROTOCOL §6c "#1315"), `R388a` (#388), `R25`. Found by the Fable review of #1367, finding 1. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] A reader opened on an MP `numreponse` link to a message of page 3 shows page 3 as current (test on `R1315b`'s body with `R1315c`'s URL). - [ ] Public-topic behaviour unchanged (`R25` redirect, `requestedURLIsNotClamped`). - [ ] The three comments above say what HFR does for `cat=prive`. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
